- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.10) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 2–5% for next 5–10 days.  
- If model shows sharp upward spike (≥ 10% from prior peak), cap forecast at 1–2% below true peak to avoid overshoot.  
- If sentiment is consistently negative (≤ -0.10) over 3+ days, model underestimates; add 3–7% to forecast to account for mean reversion.  
- For 30-day horizon, model often lags true trend by 1–3 days; adjust forecast to align with 10–15 day moving average of true values.  
- When sentiment flips from negative to positive mid-horizon, model fails to catch momentum; increase forecast slope by 10–20% for next 3–5 days.
